children: Further details or arrangements that may qualify or clarify the above or are
otherwise relevant to the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works:

The Sub-Contractor shall commence the Sub-Contract Works on the dates given in the Sub-Contract or as may otherwise be notified by the Contractor and shall thereafter continue carrying out the Sub-Contract Works regularly and diligently until complete. The Sub-Contract Works shall be completed within the Sub-Contract Period as may be adjusted pursuant to the Sub-Contract.

The Contractor reserves the right to revise its building programme in duration, extent and sequence of operations and the Sub-Contractor will comply with all directions from the Contractor to enable such a revised programme to be achieved. The Contractor does not undertake to ensure continuity of work. The Contractor shall be entitled to modify the Sub-Contractor's programme to allow for phasing suspension or stoppage of the development or accommodation of other contractors' works. The Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to exclusive access to working areas. The Sub-Contractor shall be deemed to have allowed for such modifications and for taking necessary steps to work around other contractors. No additional payments will be made in respect of any out of sequence working that may arise. All such out of sequence working required to carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works is deemed to be allowed for in the contract sum.

children: The Contractor and the Sub-Contractor for their respective interests agree that the Beneficiary shall be entitled (but not obliged) on the occurrence of a breach or breaches of the Building Contract to serve a Substitution Notice to substitute the Beneficiary or its nominee for the Contractor as the employer under the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: If the Beneficiary serves a Substitution Notice under Clause 1.1.2.2 or Clause 1.2 the Beneficiary or its nominee shall immediately assume the obligations and rights of the employer under the Sub-Contract (whether arising before or after the date of the Substitution Notice) and the Contractor shall immediately cease to have any further interest therein.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor acknowledges and agrees to the terms of this Deed and in particular agrees that the Sub-Contractor may accept instructions of the Beneficiary or its nominee in the circumstances envisaged by Clause 1.2 accepting the Substitution Notice as evidence that the Contractor is in default under the Building Contract and also agrees to the Sub-Contractor and the Beneficiary entering into a direct Contract as envisaged by Clause 3.

children.name: text
children: In the event that the Beneficiary does not substitute itself or its nominee as the employer under the Sub-Contract pursuant to Clause 1.1.2.2 or Clause 1.2 the Sub-Contractor shall at the request of the Beneficiary and on payment of all monies reasonably and properly due to the Sub-Contractor under the Sub-Contract contract direct with the Beneficiary or its nominee or assignee (if any) on the same terms as the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: [Where the Contractor and/or the Sub-Contractor has given rights in relation to the Sub-Contract similar to those contained in Clause 1 to any other person, then, if both the Beneficiary and that other person serve a Substitution Notice, the Substitution Notice served by the Beneficiary shall prevail over any other Substitution Notice served by any other person.]³

children.name: text
children: The Beneficiary shall have no liability to the Sub-Contractor under the terms of this Deed save and to the extent that it serves a Substitution Notice pursuant to Clause 1.1.2.2 and Clause 1.2.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor warrants to the Beneficiary:-

children.name: text
children: that it has been engaged by the Contractor under the Sub-Contract as sub-contractor to carry out the [design and] construction of the Sub-Contract Works

children.name: text
children: that the Sub-Contractor has complied and will comply with its obligations in accordance with the terms of the Sub-Contract and in the performance of its obligations under the Sub-Contract it has exercised and will continue to exercise all the reasonable skill, care and diligence to be expected of a qualified and competent professional designer in each of its disciplines required for the Sub-Contract Works with experience in carrying out work of a similar size, type, and complexity as the Sub-Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: ³ Clause 4 to be inserted in Funder Warranty only

children.name: text
children: that without prejudice to the generality of Clause 6.2 the Sub-Contractor agrees that the Beneficiary shall be deemed to have relied exclusively upon all the reasonable skill, care and diligence of the Sub-Contractor in relation to the performance by the Sub-Contractor of its obligations under the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor warrants to the Beneficiary that the Sub-Contractor has not used or specified and will not use or specify for use, and has exercised and will continue to exercise the standard of skill, care and diligence required by this Deed to see that there are not used in the construction of the Sub-Contract Works, any substances and materials not in conformity with any relevant British or European Standards or Codes of Practice or which are generally known to the UK building industry at the time of specification or use to be deleterious to health and safety or to the durability of the Development in the particular circumstances in which they are used, or which are not used in accordance with the guidance contained in the publication "Good Practice in the Selection of Construction Materials" (British Council for Offices)

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor warrants to the Beneficiary that it has exercised and will continue to exercise the standard of reasonable skill, care and diligence required by this Deed to see that the Sub-Contract Works are designed and constructed in accordance with all relevant statutory requirement.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor agrees that the benefit of this Deed and any rights arising under it may be assigned by the Beneficiary to any person providing finance in connection with the Development and on two other occasions to any other person with an interest in the Development without the consent of the Sub-Contractor being required. No further or other assignment of this Deed shall be permitted without the consent of the Sub-Contractor (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed).

children.name: text
children: The copyright in all drawings, reports, specifications, bills of quantities, calculations and other documents and information (including any stored electronically) prepared or provided by the Sub-Contractor in connection with the Development and the designs contained in them ("the Documents") shall remain vested in the Sub-Contractor but the Beneficiary shall have an irrevocable licence (which shall be freely assignable and include the rights to grant sub-licences) without payment of any further fee to the Sub-Contractor to use and reproduce the Documents for all purposes connected with the Beneficiary's interests in the Development, including but without limitation, any rebuilding, repair,construction, completion, maintenance, letting, promotion, advertisement and reinstatement of the Development or any part of it. The Sub-Contractor shall upon demand and subject to the payment of the Sub-Contractor's reasonable copying charges promptly supply the Beneficiary with copies of the Documents both in hard copy and in such electronic format as the Beneficiary may reasonably require. The Sub-Contractor shall not be liable for any use by the Beneficiary of any of the Documents for any purpose other than that for which the same were prepared by or on behalf of the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor undertakes to procure that there shall be granted to the Beneficiary an irrevocable licence as referred to in Clause 10.1 in relation to the documents of the same nature as the Documents provided by any party other than the Sub-Contractor for the purposes of or in connection with the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor confirms that it currently maintains and agrees that it will continue to maintain suitable professional indemnity insurance with an underwriter of repute for a sum insured of not less than £[ ] for any one claim for a period of at least twelve years from the date of the issue of the last Practical Completion Statement pursuant to the Building Contract provided always that such insurance is generally available in the market to the Sub-Contractor's profession at reasonable commercial rates and will supply the Beneficiary with documentary evidence sufficient to enable the Beneficiary to satisfy itself that such insurance is being maintained and the last premium due in respect of it has been paid whenever requested so to do. For the avoidance of doubt payment of any increased or additional premiums required by the insurers by reason of the Sub-Contractors own claims record or other acts omissions matters or things peculiar to it will be deemed to be within the Sub-Contractors obligations.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor agrees that it will use its best endeavours to see that the insurance is not invalidated or prejudiced in any way by any act default or omission by it or its employees servants or agents.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall immediately inform the Beneficiary if such insurance ceases to be available at reasonable commercial rates in order that the Sub-Contractor and the Beneficiary can discuss means of best protecting the respective positions of the Beneficiary and the Sub-Contractor in the absence of such insurance.

children.name: text
children: Within five working days of request by the Beneficiary the Sub-Contractor shall enter into deeds in favour of all or any of the parties referred to in the Building Contract such deeds to be in the form of this Deed, but excluding Clauses 1 to 5 and Clauses 12 and 13 but in all cases subject to such amendments as may be proposed by the Beneficiary and agreed by the Sub-Contractor (such agreement not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed).

children.name: text
children: The Contractor and the Sub-Contractor undertake with the Beneficiary not materially to vary or depart from the terms and conditions of the Sub-Contract without the prior written consent of the Beneficiary, and agree that no such variations or departure made without such consent shall be binding on the Beneficiary or affect or prejudice the Beneficiary's rights under this Deed or under the Sub-Contract or in any other way.

children.name: text
children: No approval given by or act or omission by or on behalf of the Beneficiary shall in any way diminish the liability of the Sub-Contractor pursuant to this Deed.

children.name: text
children: Any notice provided for in accordance with this Deed shall be deemed to be duly given if delivered by hand or sent by registered post to the relevant party at the address shown in this Deed or such other address as it may by notice in writing nominate as its address for service and if sent by registered post shall be deemed to have been served 48 hours after the time of posting (unless returned undelivered by the Post Office).

children.name: text
children: No action of proceedings for any breach of this Deed shall be commenced against the Sub-Contractor after the expiry of 12 years from the date of the issue of the last Practical Completion Statement pursuant to the Building Contract.

children.name: text
children: No term of this Deed may be enforced solely by virtue of section 1 of the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999.

children.name: text
children: This Deed shall be governed by and construed exclusively in accordance with the Laws of England and the English Courts shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes or difference that may arise.

children.name: text
children: {b:Executed as a deed} and delivered on the date shown at the head of this Deed
